name: Plantasonic Audio Configuration
description: Audio analysis and reactivity defaults. Consumed by the Audio Intelligence milestone. This file describes the analysis contract; it does not implement or modify the existing sound engine.

input.notes: The sound engine itself is out of scope for this milestone and must not be changed.

reactivity.notes: Mappings from these features to behaviors live in src/behavior/audioMappings.ts.

mood.notes: Mood vectors feed the AI Director to influence scene and behavior selection.
